implementation.lifecycle: ModifierCursorView; same key-window flagsChanged monitor, explicit mouse-event reconciliation, cursorUpdate/entry, tool/settings refresh, focus/detach cleanup. Keyboard events returned unchanged. Cursor does not steal AppKit text/control hit regions. Cached native images, no full image redraw solely for flagsChanged.
implementation.tool_policy: Exhaustive EditorTool switch. All tools receive all16 Control/Command/Option/Shift combinations. Modifiers with no dispatched function change keep the same glyph. Stroke modes follow actual captured state.
implementation.api: GET /v1/capabilities.toolCursorFeedback describes local presentation semantics and current coverage. Existing typed edits/history remain unchanged; no Adobe pointer endpoint exists in the pinned contract and none is invented.

future_requirement: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md require shared policy/lifecycle, captured-state consistency, modifier matrix regression coverage and API/discovery audit for every new tool/action.
remaining: This audit repairs feedback for existing implemented actions; it does not claim complete Photoshop modifier functionality. Brush Option temporary Eyedropper, Command temporary Move/Direct Selection, Command/Option+Space temporary Zoom and other missing Photoshop actions remain feature gaps.
Complete Photoshop pointer preferences (normal/precise/full-size, Caps Lock and brush-size HUD), exact glyphs/hotspots, exhaustive hover/resize states and physical held-key comparison remain open.
Control usually invokes contextual UI; merely holding it does not necessarily require a new tool icon. Command/Control without a dispatched alternate operation are observed without invented behavior.
Host tests do not qualify physical macOS14/Intel/macOS26 pointer appearance or performance.

Standalone focused suites that create AppKit windows before the native document-controller singleton can crash in the pre-existing close path; preserve focused03 and its isolated passing check. Key-window admission tests use an explicit controlled NSWindow subclass because xctest cannot become foreground on this host.
